- Ad Concept: 1,200 Calories Iteration
- Desire: I want to be in control of my Cravings/appetite
- Angle: Angle #2: Makes 1,200 Calories Feel Easy
- Performance testing rationale: 'I'm recreating this ad because I saw that it did actually get traction, and I think this is a real pain point for this specific avatar around being in a deficit. And so I know most people trying to lose weight obviously need something to support them through the deficit. And so I want to help them understand how eating 1200 calories is actually easy and leverage the information that I have to build belief around our mechanism. This is a very skeptical market that's heard everything for cravings, and so I want to make sure that I really show my understanding of what they're doing rather than telling them something is easy with no additional context.'
- Ad Format: Video
